summary: A Denver mother and three children became stranded in Browns Canyon near the Zoom Flume rapids after their raft began taking on water; the rafting guide put the craft ashore and the four waited in the railroad right-of-way while the mother and the guide separately called 911. Five SAR volunteers with four ATVs and a rescue trailer reached them about an hour after the ~10 p.m. Sunday call, provided food and water, and returned all four to safety by ~3 a.m. Monday.
location: Browns Canyon, Zoom Flume rapids area
notes: FIBArk weekend incident; date pinned to Sunday June 15, 2014 (weekday-verified; mission concluded ~3 a.m. Monday June 16). Subjects: Clarre Behrens, 35, her children Anastasia Behrens, 11, and Alana Behrens, 7, and David Perrie, 9; guide Chris Banks, 37. Put in at Fisherman's Bridge.
